result:
I would make empathy instantaneous and unavoidable.

Not as a slogan, but as a lived experience. If you could actually feel, even for a moment, what it feels like to be on the receiving end of your own words, your own policies, your own neglect — you wouldn't be able to do most of the cruel and careless things people do by accident.

Everything else follows from that.
